items.title: Reread your SOP
items.detail: They can ask about anything you wrote. Be ready to talk about every line.

items.title: Why this course?
items.detail: Expect this question. Prepare a clear answer in your own words.

items.title: Ask your own questions
items.detail: Keep one or two questions about the course, projects or student life.

items.title: Check your tech first
items.detail: Camera, mic, internet and a quiet room. Test them beforehand.
